column1: # Phrase pass. Aaron, 2026-09-06.  VIDEO ONLY -- no model output.
# `phrase`  what kind of action it was. Pick one:
#   clean          one fencer clearly attacks, the other clearly defends or retreats
#   close-blade    close quarters, a series of blade actions -- readable to you, but
#   attack-in-prep priority went to the fencer moving BACK, who lunged into the other's
# `difficulty` 1-10, higher = harder. Already filled for bouts 8-12; blank for 13-14.
#   1 = obvious, a referee giving it the other way would surprise you
# `agree` optional y/n -- would you have called it the same way?
# Do a whole bout before moving on. Blank beats a forced guess.
